rationale: Every run is limited by an I/O-port path at ss/100C, and T_eff falls with the target because IO delays scale with the period; reg-to-reg needs only ~4.2-4.4 ns, so keep period_frac 0.45. Hold, slew/cap and DRC are clean, with no congestion. The near-identical round-1 pair shows density_delta 24 beating 8 by 0.75 ns (wirelength 4,040 vs 4,928): compact placement helps, and the optimizer, now centred on that run, should keep density high, so I free RC_MODEL (it favours orfs) and pin routability-driven placement off, since it spreads cells. Keep timing-driven placement, slew margin 35% (~70 extra buffers, faster port paths), low util (high-util runs failed), DELAY 3, and post-GRT timing/design repair for tight-clock re-runs.
